risks.risk: Not actually fully functional (common issues: scanner not reading, paper feed jams, drum/toner problems, fuser issues). Photos can’t confirm operation.

risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven functional (worst case: assume it may need service/consumables).

risks.risk: Consumables/maintenance state unknown (toner/drum life, waste toner, fuser wear).
risks.proof: Photo of toner/drum/waste toner compartments (or any maintenance counters/status screen) plus a close-up of any 'toner low'/'replace' indicators.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming consumables may be low/near end-of-life.

risks.risk: Paper feed and alignment issues (rollers, pickup tray, registration) not visible.

Short video of a successful copy (from start to finished output page).
Photo of the machine’s status/display (no errors) and/or maintenance counters.
Photos of toner/drum/waste toner compartments and any 'replace/low' indicators.
Photo of included accessories (power cable, any interface cables, trays/ADF parts).
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a Sharp all-in-one copier/printer, but the exact model (AR-M201 vs M301) and functional status cannot be verified remotely; a working test and model-label close-up are needed before pricing confidently.
